summary: The exact V3.1 static allowlist and validator close the current ASCII metadata projection, reject duplicate JSON keys, bind the predecessor and source-manifest hashes, and derive the exact 13 governed / 8 replace / 5 guard-only / 3 sentinel counts. The native bundle is not qualified. First, the exported NativeHandleLeaseV31 lets a caller add a new resource registration for any retained parent label and one-component leaf, then obtain an opaque token and request GENERIC_WRITE or DELETE access through probe_contention. That contradicts the record claim that no arbitrary caller write/delete effect surface exists; the token is opaque, but its binding is caller-mutable. Second, collect_test_only_temp_root rejects every one-component token, while the exact V3.1 allowlist has three one-component model-root sentinels with parent_token '.'. The helper therefore cannot measure the exact governed sentinel shape or prove that dot resolves to the retained model-root identity. The tests use nested synthetic sentinel paths and do not exercise either defect. The native architecture source, cleanup nonauthority, metadata/cloud uncertainty, and non-exhaustive process nonclaims are otherwise honest. Retained fixtures remain declared evidence only and were not inspected or mutated.

findings.title: Exported lease permits caller-defined write/delete-open targets

evidence.observation: The public retain and register_resource methods accept caller-supplied labels, handles, parent labels, kinds, ordinals and leaves. contention_token then returns the caller-created token and probe_contention forwards the retained parent handle and caller-selected leaf.
The forwarded probe requests GENERIC_WRITE or DELETE access. It performs no write/delete operation, but the access request itself is the bounded effect under review.
The emitted record nevertheless asserts issued-token-only selection and arbitrary_caller_path_write_delete_api_present false.

Tests reject a raw path passed directly to probe_contention and check selected method names, but never attempt public register_resource misuse or prove the resource registry immutable after collection.

findings.risk: A caller holding the returned lease can mint a new selector for a non-governed sibling under any retained parent label and cause a write/delete-access open request. This is capability-by-caller-discipline rather than containment-by-construction and repeats the effect class rejected by the V3 boss, with a handle/leaf selector replacing the old raw Path parameter.
findings.required_repair: Make resource registration and arbitrary handle retention inaccessible after internal collection, freeze the issued resource map before returning the lease, bind every token to one exact internally verified target or sentinel identity, and make the probe reject any unissued or post-freeze registration before NtOpenFile. Add a negative that attempts to register a new target and proves the native open primitive is never called.

findings.title: Native helper cannot represent the exact model-root sentinels

evidence.observation: All three exact sentinels are one-component path_token values whose parent_token is '.'.
The collector rejects any target or sentinel token with fewer than two components.
Parent handles are built only from nonempty parent-token paths; there is no '.' mapping to the retained model handle and model identity.
The fixtures move the sentinels under a synthetic sentinels/ directory, so the green Windows evidence never exercises the exact allowlist shape.

findings.risk: The claimed exact allowlist/native continuity is not executable for the three global sentinel guards. A later wrapper must either reinterpret the paths, prefix them, or bypass this collector, each of which reopens the model-root identity and scope-substitution defect that V3 was rejected for.
findings.required_repair: Support parent_token '.' as one explicit non-escaping case that maps directly to the already retained model handle, embed that exact model identity as each root sentinel's parent identity, and reject every other empty/dot/dotdot representation. Run a disposable-fixture test using the exact three one-component sentinel token shapes.

findings.title: Adversarial native and every-field allowlist evidence remains incomplete

evidence.observation: The seven test functions cover a green fixture, direct opaque-token use, a token escape, one hardlink, one final-component reparse attempt, architecture/effect labels and absence of selected public names. They do not cover caller re-registration, the exact root sentinels, root/parent substitution, integrated ancestor reparse chains, access denial, process exit, PID reuse, partial process inventory, executable ambiguity, or cleanup substitution.
The allowlist negatives sample important fields and path cases but do not provide the boss-required negative for every closed field and every exact target/sentinel descriptor.
Formal pytest remains coverage_unavailable; the full native suite was not rerun after the private-method rename, and the retained fixtures are lower-grade declared evidence.

findings.risk: The existing direct successes cannot establish that every sustained V3 bypass is closed, and they specifically miss both critical defects found in this review.
findings.required_repair: Add deterministic no-effect negatives for the two critical findings and complete the boss-required adversarial matrix. Add table-driven allowlist mutations covering every top-level, nested, target and sentinel field while retaining duplicate-key and normalized-path negatives. Keep formal pytest coverage_unavailable until it actually runs.

findings.title: Static file validator accepts arbitrary caller read paths while claiming fixed inputs

evidence.observation: The module claims only three immutable metadata artifacts are opened.
validate_files publicly accepts three caller-supplied Path values and reads them before proving they are the declared fixed paths. Exact hashes constrain bytes, not access location.
The test checks only the default constants and does not reject alternate caller paths.

findings.risk: A same-byte copy, hardlink, reparse target or alternate location can be opened and may incur access-metadata or cloud-hydration effects outside the three declared paths, while the result still says canonical_or_global_targets_opened false.
findings.required_repair: Make the frozen file validator no-argument and fixed-path-only; keep validate_objects as the injection surface for tests. If alternate files are intentionally supported, report their exact resolved identities and access scope instead of claiming fixed inputs.

exact_hash_closure.details: The freeze, native helper/tests, allowlist/validator/tests and normative V3 boss rejection all matched their supplied SHA-256 values.

static_allowlist_cli.details: One read-only default-path invocation returned 13 governed, 8 replacement, 5 guard-only and 3 sentinel rows with exact predecessor and V6 source projections.

semantic_schema_closure.details: The exact allowlist top level and nested predecessor, source-render, normalization, count, target and sentinel objects are closed; exact IDs, roles, order and operation descriptors are pinned. Test completeness remains a separate blocker.

duplicate_json_keys.details: UTF-8 JSON parsing uses an object_pairs_hook that rejects duplicate keys at every object level.

path_normalization.details: The validator enforces NFC, slash-separated relative tokens, derived parent/leaf equality, no dot/dotdot/ADS/trailing-dot-or-space/reserved-device form, and combined target/sentinel casefold uniqueness. No portability claim beyond the exact current paths is made.

operation_partition.details: All 13 rows remain governed; ordinals 1,2,3,5,7,8,10,12 are replace and ordinals 4,6,9,11,13 are guard_only. Guard rows have exact preimage/staged equality and replacement rows have exact inequality.

native_architecture_source.details: Architecture is taken from GetNativeSystemInfo and IsWow64Process2 rather than PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE.

cleanup_authority.details: The helper closes retained handles but exposes no file deletion, recursive cleanup or pathname cleanup authority. The six retained fixtures remain intentionally retained by declared evidence.

process_nonclaim.details: The process evidence is explicitly diagnostic current ancestry only, non-exhaustive, production-ineligible and not writer exclusion.

metadata_and_cloud_effects.details: Access-time and cloud-hydration effects are unmeasured_may_change and zero filesystem effect is not claimed.

handle_continuity_for_nested_fixture_mem.details: The helper retains volume, test-root, workspace, model, nested parent and file handles and revalidates their identities/bytes before sealing. This does not cure the absent model-root dot-parent projection or the caller-mutable lease registry.

preserved_appeals_and_dissent.position: The test-only helper can remain useful without production process closure.
preserved_appeals_and_dissent.reason: Native architecture, identity, hashing and honest process nonclaims are informative, but the exact bundle cannot qualify while the effect and model-root defects remain.

preserved_appeals_and_dissent.position: Opaque tokens and caller discipline are sufficient containment.
preserved_appeals_and_dissent.reason: Opacity does not establish provenance when the exported lease lets the caller populate the token registry with a new parent/leaf binding.

preserved_appeals_and_dissent.position: Exact whole-file hashes make semantic allowlist checks redundant.
preserved_appeals_and_dissent.reason: The exact hash is necessary identity evidence; the V3.1 semantic validator is also necessary and currently passes the exact metadata artifact.

preserved_appeals_and_dissent.position: All 13 targets must stay governed even when five have no byte transition.
preserved_appeals_and_dissent.reason: The static allowlist implements the boss-required 13/8/5 operation partition exactly.

preserved_appeals_and_dissent.position: Formal test evidence can be inferred from direct function success.
preserved_appeals_and_dissent.reason: Formal pytest remains coverage_unavailable and was not rerun or promoted by this review.

preserved_strict_writer_race_dissent.reason: Even a repaired bounded native collector and replacement protocol cannot exclude every pre-opened, future, hidden, kernel, sync or noncooperating writer, nor eliminate all precheck-to-rename lost-update or post-readback races.

validation_performed.scope: freeze, all seven freeze-listed artifacts, normative V3 boss rejection
exact native helper/tests and allowlist/validator/tests only

next_action: Preserve the exact V3.1 freeze and this dissent as non-authorizing review evidence. Create a newly named native/test generation that freezes the lease resource registry, removes caller registration/retention authority, supports the exact one-component model-root sentinels with parent identity equal to the retained model handle, and adds the missing adversarial negatives. Keep the exact V3.1 static allowlist semantics and 13/8/5 split, but make fixed-file validation path-honest. Obtain fresh native/allowlist peer, root challenge, premortem and boss ruling before any component lock or launcher work.
